question: What features are not supported in self-hosted Fern documentation deployments?
ground_truth: Self-hosted Fern documentation deployments do not support features requiring external connections, including Ask Fern (AI chat), analytics, live API key population, and SSO integrations. Additionally, PDF export and offline AI chat functionality are not yet available but are in development for enterprise self-hosted deployments.

metadata.cited_context: Self-hosted deployments include core Fern documentation website features like auto-generated API references, interactive documentation, SDK code snippets, search, and customizable branding. However, features requiring external connections aren't supported, including Ask Fern (AI chat), analytics, live API key population, and SSO integrations. PDF export and offline AI chat functionality are not yet available on any plan but are in development for enterprise self-hosted deployments.
